text: 证监会：针对市场热点难点会计实务问题加强实践指导 不断增强资本市场执行企业会计准则与财务信息披露规则的一致性、有效性
text_en: CSRC: Strengthen practical guidance on hot and difficult accounting issues in the market, continuously enhance consistency and effectiveness of capital market implementation of enterprise accounting standards and financial disclosure rules
